name: Feature request
about: Suggest an improvement to doc-translator-action
title: '[Feature] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem

What are you trying to do that the action doesn't currently support? Describe the gap, not just the solution.

## Proposed solution

What would you like to happen? If it touches AST parsing/reconstruction, note which Markdown constructs are involved (see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md#ast-guidelines) for the extraction/reconstruction model).

## Alternatives considered

Any workarounds you're using today (a custom `config-path`, a specific `output-path-template`, a `.doc-ignore` pattern, etc.) and why they're insufficient.

## Additional context

Links, examples from other tools (Docusaurus i18n, MkDocs static-i18n, ...), or anything else that helps scope this.
